align_sequences_with_kalign: create a Kalign instance with a binary path and call align on a list of sequence strings
convert_sequences_to_a3m: call _to_a3m with a list of sequence strings to get an A3M formatted string
run_multiple_sequence_alignment: build a script that aligns multiple biological sequences using the Kalign wrapper and returns A3M output
validate_sequence_length: test the Kalign align method to ensure it raises ValueError for sequences shorter than 6 residues
review_kalign_wrapper: review the Kalign class to understand how it invokes the Kalign binary via subprocess
